name: bank-marketing-analysis
description: End-to-end bank marketing analysis and customer subscription prediction using Python, machine learning, and Streamlit.

paragraphs: An end-to-end data analytics and machine learning project. The Portuguese bank marketing dataset was used to assess feature importance related to customers and campaign methods to subscribe to a term deposit. The analyses include customer demographics and behaviour, financial situation (both customer level and macroeconomic information), and marketing campaign characteristics.

The project combines exploratory data analysis (EDA), statistical analysis, feature engineering, machine learning, and an interactive Streamlit application for customer-level predictions and marketing insights.

The main objective is to investigate which customer and campaign characteristics are associated with term-deposit subscriptions and develop a classification model that can help identify customers with a higher probability of subscribing.
features: Machine learning - comparison of logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost models
Model evaluation using multiple classification metrics
